snippet.title: Steel Artery: Train City Builder | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Step aboard the Steel Artery, a living city on rails!
Build, manage, and expand your steampunk fantasy train-city where every wagon is a piece of infrastructure and every citizen shapes their own destiny.

In Steel Artery: Train City Builder, you’ll manage multiracial colonies, balance resources, and keep your empire alive as your colossal train traverses distant regions. Will your Steelpolis rise again—or will it collapse under its own weight?

Key Features
 • Unique train-based city building with wagon expansions
 • Thousands of autonomous citizens with emergent behavior
 • Humans, elves, orcs & more with unique cultural needs
 • Economy & logistics management across diverse regions
 • Atmospheric steampunk fantasy world with pixel art visuals
 • Endless replayability with evolving city layouts

🔔 Stay tuned for more updates on development and release news!
👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602030/Steel_Artery_Train_City_Builder/

#SteelArtery #CityBuilder #Steampunk
